answer: Use `/github signout` in the GitHub app DM. GitHub Docs says this command “disconnects your GitHub account from your Slack user,” and the app stays installed in the workspace because installation is separate from your personal connection. If you only want to stop being mentioned in Slack notifications, remove the repo notifications you subscribed to with `/github unsubscribe OWNER/REPO ...`; GitHub Docs says you will be mentioned in Slack when repository events reference you, such as assignment or a comment mention.
